evidence.excerpt: Nutrition5k often photographed the same plate several times, so a random test split shared near-identical photographs with training and overstated accuracy.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We fine-tuned DINOv2-base on 2,253 weighed Nutrition5k dishes to predict mass from one RGB photograph and compared it with a zero-shot vision-language model, Qwen3-VL-32B, on Nutrition5k and three external datasets: ASA24 studio portions, ECUSTFD whole foods and Food Portion Benchmark meal trays.
